intent_text: [main] Allow editing Shop.name via shopSettingsUpdate (#19469) Extend `ShopSettingsInput` with a new `name` field (ADDED_IN_3.23) so the shop's name can be updated through `shopSettingsUpdate`, alongside the existing `shopDomainUpdate` mutation. The name is stored on the Django `Site` object (not on `SiteSettings`), so it is popped from the cleaned input before `construct_instance` and written to the `Site` separately. `clean_instance` runs before saving so that an over-length name (Site.name is max_length=50) returns a proper ValidationError instead of a database error. Adds tests covering a successful name update and the too-long-name validation error, and regenerates the GraphQL schema. Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
